verdict.rationale: WorkOS RBAC docs say developers can define custom roles and permissions, including organization-scoped ones, via the Dashboard or API, and enforce access policies. The docs also say roles are enforced through session JWTs with AuthKit, and IdP role assignment works via SSO and Directory Sync. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the JWT claim structure and permission-check examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of token-based enforcement.
